Package game.events

Class MoveEvent

java.lang.Object
game.events.GameEvent
game.events.MoveEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.lang.Comparable<GameEvent>
public class MoveEvent
extends GameEvent
An event that declares the request for moves being displayed on the screen, only one MoveEvent is allowed to exist at the same time, creating a new MoveEvent while another one is still in the queue will replace the old event
